findings.finding: A code-review coaching move scoped via `applies_when: ["project.symbol-reference-completeness"]` would be a permanently dead move. The code-review Pass-4 builds `active_triggers` from the union of `criteria` values carried by surviving findings (`workflow_ops.code_review_coach_inputs`, line 474), and those criteria values are drawn exclusively from the closed `OVERLAY_IDS` vocabulary (`security`, `tests`, `llm-prompts`, etc.). A project criterion id (`project.*`) is never a code-review finding's `criteria` value, so the `applies_when` intersection would always be empty and the move would never be offered to the coach LLM.
findings.location: Scope section / Approach section — 'Where it routes is a real decision to make from the existing machinery'
findings.suggested_fix: Route the new criterion and its coaching move exclusively to `plan_review` (where `applies_when` criterion ids from surviving findings already work), and record in the ticket that code-review moves cannot be scoped to project criterion ids under the current closed OVERLAY_IDS vocabulary — a follow-on story would require either adding a project-aware `applies_when` expansion or using `"always"` as the code-review move's tag.
